about: A Python dictionary with extra powers, including reading and writing CSV, JSON, INI, TOML and other file formats in one call.

prs.title: Files saved by Excel and Windows tools load correctly
prs.broken: Files that start with an invisible byte order mark, which Excel and older Windows tools add, failed to load or got a garbled first column name.
prs.changed: Text files are now read in a way that skips that mark, and files without it load as before.
prs.matters: CSV exports from Excel and similar files work without cleaning them up first.
